bundle.shortDescription: Cute animated mint-green living desktop pet and Dynamic Island
bundle.longDescription: Mintu is a lightweight animated desktop pet living in a Dynamic Island widget with Free Desktop mode, SMTC music controls, notifications, focus timer, and interactive wardrobe.
